_comment: The ONE configuration file for the Palette NEAT SDK Demo UI.
web.port           8022 - see the note under "web" below
insight.vf_port    8081 - Insight's vf process: /static/drawing.js and POST /offer
video/metadata UDP 9000+N / 9100+N - Insight's ingest ports, the DevKit sends to them
Command-line flags on run.sh / backend/server.py override anything here.

_port: WHY 8022 AND NOT 9910.
This UI usually runs INSIDE the Neat SDK container (172.18.0.2).  A port
opened there is reachable at https://127.0.0.1:<port> only from inside
that container - the SDK publishes a FIXED list of ports to the host and
the LAN, and a new one is not on it:
neat --json -> exposedPorts
tcp  9900 mainUI      9999 codeUI     10000 codeUIHttps
tcp  8081 videoUI     8554 rtsp.tcp    8022 webSSH
udp  9000-9003 videoUDP  9100-9103 metadataUDP  40000-40007 webRTC
Measured, not assumed: a plain HTTP listener started in the container on
8022 answered http://10.42.0.1:8022 from the DevKit, while 9910 gave
'connection refused' - which is exactly the reported symptom, that
https://127.0.0.1:9910 cannot be opened.
Of that published list, 9900 (Insight), 8081 (vf), 8554 (rtsp), 9999 and
10000 (the code UI) are all in use inside the container.  8022 is the
only published TCP port with nothing listening on it, so it is the only
one this UI can take and still be reachable from a browser.  It is the
SDK's web-SSH port; nothing serves it in this image, and if you ever
need web SSH, move this UI with ./run.sh --port N and open it from
inside the container instead.
Running this on the SDK HOST instead of in the container removes the
whole question - any port works there.  ./run.sh prints which of the two
situations it is in and which URL actually works.

_host: The machine running Neat Insight.  This is NOT necessarily the machine
running this UI: Insight lives in the Neat SDK container on the SDK host,
so running the UI on the DevKit means pointing this at the SDK host.
'local' / '127.0.0.1' means 'Insight is on this same machine'.

_comment: The voice runtime (Whisper-medium + Qwen3-0.6B on the Modalix MLA) runs ON THE
DEVKIT, on loopback, owned by ./run.sh, which passes --voice-host/--voice-port
from config/default.env (VOICE_PORT); host/port here are only fallbacks.
language is the language the page starts in at every load: ko, en or auto.
The operator can switch it on the page at any time (Language: Auto | KO | EN);
the choice lasts for that page.

_latency: video_sync_buffer_ms is deliberate browser latency: each decoded frame is held
this long so the metadata for that frame has arrived and the boxes sit on the
object. 45 ms is the lowest measured value with no missed overlays on either
